title: Edit Customer and New Customer representative fields look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-A} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 2, boards 2.3 to 2.12 and 2.16 to 2.18.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer and compare the field with board 2.3.
  2. Hover over the + and open its menu; compare with boards 2.6 and 2.7.
  3. Add Service Parts and Part Sales, pick {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}, and compare with board 2.12.
  4. Hover over a remove x; compare with board 2.13.
  5. Close the window without saving, open New Customer and compare with boards 2.16 and 2.17.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the field has the same outlined box as every other field in the window, in the place Edit Customer shows it today; the arrow is vertically centred; the + shows without hovering; no x inside the field.
  • Step 2: the tooltip "Add representative"; the menu lists "Sales Representative - Service Parts" then "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  • Step 3: three fields in order: "Sales Representative - Service Labor", "Sales Representative - Service Parts", "Sales Representative - Part Sales"; each added field has a remove x and the + is gone; labels in full.
  • Step 4: the tooltip reads "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  • Step 5: New Customer shows the same field and + as Edit Customer.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R1, S4-R4, S4-R5, S4-R6, S4-R9, S4-R10, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 2, boards 2.3 to 2.18, used for the picture to compare against. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The design's customer list shows names that are not in A to Z order (boards 2.4 and 2.11). The PRD says A to Z by first name, then last name; this case and the customer-window list case follow the PRD, and the difference is on the product owner's question list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R4: “No field in the window has an x inside it; picking "Unassigned" clears it (S1-R10). Each field's dropdown arrow is vertically centered (S1-R11). In the window the + and the remove x are always shown; they do not wait for hover.”
  • S4-R5: “The + button of S2-R1 to S2-R3 sits to the right of the first field, with the tooltip "Add representative".”
  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”
  • S4-R9: “The fields always show in this order: the first field ("Sales Representative", or "Sales Representative - Service Labor" once Service Parts is added), then Service Parts, then Part Sales.”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”
